source: USGS NLDI (NHDPlus V2) downstream-mainstem flowlines for routing; USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages for pin distances; NPS Buffalo NR river-mile chart; AGFC water-trail tables
method: Points are ordered per river by chainage along the NLDI downstream-mainstem path from the top point (Buffalo: NPS river miles); points closer than 1 mile are merged (agency-preferred point kept). Buffalo sections follow the NPS trip pages. Mileage priority: NPS river miles > AGFC water-trail table (only where the access identity is clear) > NLDI chainage.

offReach.Brookings Boat Ramp: Off the routed reach (NLDI distance 2060.8 m): 2.1 km from the routed NHDPlus V2 Black River line (likely an old channel/slough); research-only.
offReach.Dripping Springs Boat Ramp: Off the routed reach (NLDI distance 1110.7 m): 1.1 km from the routed NHDPlus V2 Little Red River line; research-only.
offReach.Pinnacle Mountain State Park - Little Ma: Off the routed reach (NLDI distance 1693.2 m): routes to the Maumelle River, not the Little Maumelle; research-only.
offReach.Dark Corner Spur Boating Access: Off the routed reach (NLDI distance 489.0 m): off the main Bayou DeView channel (spur); AGFC lists Dark Corner as a water-trail access; research-only.
offReach.Hickson Lake Boat Ramp: Off the routed reach (NLDI distance 1843.1 m): on Hickson Lake (oxbow) off the routed Bayou DeView line; AGFC lists it as a water-trail access; research-only.
